candidates.title: Typed calendar date renders as the previous day west of UTC
candidates.evidence_detail: Held-out jest tests render a user-typed YYYY-MM-DD under a negative-offset TZ (TZ=America/Los_Angeles) and assert the same calendar day is shown and stored.
candidates.privacy_note: Civic-assistant app is private; ship only the custom-action date component plus a synthetic test harness.
candidates.summary: A date typed into a custom action was parsed with new Date('YYYY-MM-DD') (UTC midnight) and displayed a day early for western time zones. Agent must fix parsing/storage so the local calendar date round-trips, without regressing existing date rendering.
candidates.grader_image: needs-image: linux container with node 22 + jest

candidates.title: Explicit LOOSE/HELD/IN_FLIGHT possession model for a multi-sport match sim
candidates.evidence_detail: Hidden gdUnit4 tests drive the headless MatchSim: possession state transitions (loose->held->in_flight), carrier-held ball follows player, soccer rules unchanged; golden-replay determinism test still passes.
candidates.privacy_note: Private game repo; task text describes the sim architecture generically. Code stays in a private grader image.
candidates.summary: The fixed-tick match sim assumed the ball is never parented to a player (a soccer-only rule). Agent adds an explicit possession model so carry/hand-off sports are expressible, keeping soccer behavior and replay determinism intact.
candidates.grader_image: needs-image: linux container with godot 4.x headless + gdUnit4

candidates.title: Normalize wallpaper swipe travel by physical (dp) distance across foldable panels
candidates.evidence_detail: Held-out JVM unit tests on the extracted drag->travel mapping: identical physical drag (dp) yields identical world travel on a narrow and a 2x-wide panel; existing tests pass.
candidates.privacy_note: Public repo.
candidates.summary: Swipe travel was normalized by screen width, so on the wide inner display the same finger motion moved the camera half as far. Agent changes the live wallpaper to measure drag in density-independent pixels with a fixed distance per world.
candidates.grader_image: needs-image: linux container with android sdk/gradle (JVM unit tests)

candidates.title: Keep mic and loopback channels separate for exact telehealth diarization
candidates.evidence_detail: Held-out cargo tests on synthetic two-channel PCM: output is stereo with channel identity preserved after resampling, and channel-energy diarization labels each synthetic utterance with the right speaker.
candidates.privacy_note: Private clinical app; never use real audio. Synthetic tones/noise per channel only.
candidates.summary: Capture recorded microphone and system loopback separately, then averaged them into mono, discarding free speaker separation. Agent preserves channels through resampling and adds channel-based diarization.
candidates.grader_image: not-containerizable: requires cloud-windows (rust stable + cargo test (Tauri host))
